identificationModule.officialTitle: Does Modulation of Glutamate Transmission in the Brain Using a Sub-anaesthetic Dose of Ketamine Affect Autobiographical Memory, Emotional Processing and Decision-making in Treatment-resistant Depression?

primaryOutcomes.measure: Change in magnitude of negative and positive valence adjectives in the autobiographical memory task using a self-reported questionnaire.

Brain activation as measured by functional magnetic resonance in a network of areas related to autobiographical memories, including the medial prefrontal cortex and associated networks during the autobiographical memory task.
